purpose: test whether an exact interaction-order lift from K3 to K4 resolves the spent C/D final-stage ambiguity using witness-projected scalar retention and proof-safe local-order LP certificates
scientific_question: after K3 convex pruning certifies A/B impossible but leaves C/D ambiguous, does exact degree-four interaction information certify wrong final stage C while preserving true final stage D on the same already-spent Pythia-14M ABCD target?
witness_definition: for each final-stage class j, recompute the frozen K3 six-vertex convex projection p_j before any degree-four output and set u_j=(target-p_j)/||target-p_j||; every witness is therefore fixed using K3 information only
witness_freeze_order: all four K3 witnesses must be fully constructed and unit-norm checked before the first degree-four active-lift transition is executed
witness_projection_retention: retain only scalar projections of degree-four endpoints/interactions plus direct scalar endpoint errors; no degree-four model-space interaction tensor may be retained
active_lift_definition: for word abcd, reconstruct exact K3 prefix endpoint E(abc) from measured degree<=3 interactions, apply stage d exactly once, project E(abcd)-base onto each frozen K3 witness, and recover the projected degree-four interaction by scalar Mobius subtraction
active_lift_exactness_scope: because every prefix has length three, K3 reconstructs that prefix exactly; each measured length-four active lift is therefore the exact deterministic endpoint for that complete chronology up to numerical replay
hierarchy_scope: generic nonnegative local-order marginal hierarchy through K=4 with simplex and adjacent-level marginal consistency
terminal_exactness: for N=4 and K=4, the highest-level simplex is a distribution over all 24 full permutations, so each fixed-final-stage LP is exactly a convexification of its six complete chronologies
decision_scope: A/B remain pruned by the frozen K3 certificate; K4 makes a new scientific decision only on survivor C versus D. A/B K4 scores are reported only as terminal-exactness diagnostics.
elimination_rule: a survivor final-stage class is certified impossible only if max(0, corrected K4 LP lower bound) exceeds exact_feasible_upper_bound_error + numerical_elimination_guard; D must never be eliminated
lp_solver: scipy.optimize.linprog highs proposes primal/equality-dual values; the reported lower bound is independently corrected using subset simplex minima of any dual reduced-cost residual
required_sanity_checks: source K3 convex protocol and selection hashes and run identities match the frozen partial-pruning result
spent codebook seed is not any prohibited held-out confirmation seed
target endpoint hash exactly replays ABCD before K4 measurement
all four K3 witnesses are constructed and unit-norm checked before any degree-four active-lift transition
exact K3 prefix reconstruction plus one final stage reproduces the ABCD target hash for the ABCD degree-four word
all 24 degree-four projected Mobius reconstructions reproduce direct endpoint projections for all four witnesses within tolerance
K4 local-order LP corrected lower bound is no larger than the direct exact fixed-last-stage directional minimum
at K=N=4, K4 LP primal objective matches the direct exact fixed-last-stage directional minimum within tolerance
every reported directional lower bound is no larger than the direct exact Euclidean class distance beyond tolerance
D has direct exact class distance zero within tolerance and is not eliminated
strong_success_requires: C is certified impossible by its K4 witness while D survives and all exactness/certificate sanity checks pass
scientific_negative_requires: C is not certified impossible, D survives, and all exactness/certificate sanity checks pass
invalid_run_requires: D is eliminated, ABCD active-lift endpoint does not exactly replay the target, any source/hash/held-out gate fails, or any projected-Mobius/terminal-exactness/certificate inequality fails
interpretation_scope: this spent N=4 terminal-level experiment validates the witness-projected active-lift and proof-safe K-local certificate machinery and can establish interaction certificate depth <=4 on this instance; it is not itself a scalability result because K=N makes the terminal level factorial
next_step_if_strong_success: freeze the projected K-local certificate hierarchy as the mechanism baseline; for N>4 keep K fixed, branch only on survivors, and require an explicit directional omitted-interaction bound before any exact chronology claim
next_step_if_scientific_negative: the frozen K3 witness is not sufficient even with exact degree-four information; before changing witness construction, audit whether survivor-specific adaptive witnesses can be generated without looking at held-out outputs and validate them on synthetic/spent data only
launch_blockers: integrated synthetic test must show frozen-witness projected Mobius recovery and K=N corrected-LP/direct-score agreement
cheap CI must pass on the frozen protocol, runner, workflow, and launch gate with no research-scale trigger present
launch marker may be added only after that CI pass and must preserve spent-only and held-out-blocked fields
